# Each check, what it tests

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_checks_doc.py from fpgas-verify's board modules. Do not edit: change the board module, then run `uv run python scripts/gen_checks_doc.py`. -->

A section for every check fpgas-verify runs on a board, named as the fpgas.online dashboards name it: for each board type that gets the check, what it checks and what the check runs. How the whole check runs, and the details of each test, are on [what the check tests on each board](tests.md) and [what an Acorn check tests](acorn.md#acorn).

Checks: [`pcie-link`](#pcie-link), [`pcie-bar0`](#pcie-bar0), [`rp1-pio`](#rp1-pio), [`jtag`](#jtag), [`flash`](#flash), [`ddr`](#ddr), [`p2-uart`](#p2-uart), [`p2-serial`](#p2-serial), [`scratch`](#scratch), [`p2-gpio`](#p2-gpio), [`wiring`](#wiring), [`power-cycle`](#power-cycle), [`uart`](#uart), [`ethernet`](#ethernet), [`header`](#header), [`foboot`](#foboot), [`foboot-after`](#foboot-after), [`sdk`](#sdk), [`dip-switches`](#dip-switches), [`spram`](#spram).

## Boot check

The check fpgas-verify runs at every boot of a Pi with an FPGA board: it finds the board, runs every check below that the board's type gets, in order, and reports one result for the boot: `pass` (every check passed), `fail` (a check failed), `error` (the check could not finish), or `missing` (it found no board). The dashboards show it as the Boot check column; a board is offered to visitors only after a `pass`. [Reading the result](reading-the-result.md) says what each result means.

## Check ran

When the boot check of the boot the Pi is running reported its result (its `fpga-verified` event). A Pi checks again at its next boot; until then this time does not change.

## pcie-bar0

| Board | Variants | What it checks | What the check runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sqrl Acorn | every | over PCIe BAR0: the build running, the flash's identity, the device DNA, the XADC readings | the Acorn suite ([what an Acorn check tests](acorn.md#acorn)) |

## rp1-pio

| Board | Variants | What it checks | What the check runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sqrl Acorn | every | the Pi 5's RP1 PIO, which JTAG uses, is there and can be opened | the Acorn suite ([what an Acorn check tests](acorn.md#acorn)) |

## jtag

| Board | Variants | What it checks | What the check runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sqrl Acorn | every | over the P1 cable, the JTAG IDCODE and device DNA read, and the DNA is BAR0's | the Acorn suite ([what an Acorn check tests](acorn.md#acorn)) |
| Digilent Arty A7 | `a7-35` | over its FT2232H, the JTAG IDCODE is an XC7A35T's and the device DNA reads | reads the JTAG IDCODE and device DNA; loads nothing |
| Kosagi NeTV2 | `a7-35`, `a7-100` | over the Pi's header, the JTAG IDCODE is the variant's part and the device DNA reads | reads the JTAG IDCODE and device DNA; loads nothing |

Not for:

* Fomu EVT (`evt`): the iCE40UP5K has no JTAG port: the Fomu is loaded over USB DFU, by foboot
* TT FPGA Demo Board (`tt-fpga`): the iCE40UP5K has no JTAG port: it is loaded through the demo board's RP2350
* TT FPGA Demo Board (`tt-asic`): a Tiny Tapeout chip is an ASIC, not an FPGA: nothing on it is configured over JTAG
* TT FPGA Demo Board (not yet known): neither a TT FPGA breakout (an iCE40UP5K, loaded through the RP2350) nor a Tiny Tapeout chip has a JTAG port

## flash

| Board | Variants | What it checks | What the check runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sqrl Acorn | every | both flash slots are read whole and match the release's images | the Acorn suite ([what an Acorn check tests](acorn.md#acorn)) |
| Digilent Arty A7 | `a7-35` | a test design reads the SPI flash's JEDEC ID | loads its test design, then runs [`test_spiflash.py`](../../designs/spi-flash-id/host/test_spiflash.py) |
| Fomu EVT | `evt` | a test design loaded over DFU reads the SPI flash's JEDEC ID: the EVT's W25Q128JV (ef7018) | loads its test design, then runs [`test_spiflash.py`](../../designs/spi-flash-id/host/test_spiflash.py) |
| Kosagi NeTV2 | `a7-35`, `a7-100` | a test design reads the SPI flash's JEDEC ID | loads its test design, then runs [`test_spiflash.py`](../../designs/spi-flash-id/host/test_spiflash.py) |

Not for:

* TT FPGA Demo Board (`tt-fpga`): the FPGA breakout has no configuration flash: the RP2350 streams each design from the Pi
* TT FPGA Demo Board (`tt-asic`): a Tiny Tapeout chip is an ASIC: it has no configuration flash to test
* TT FPGA Demo Board (not yet known): neither a TT FPGA breakout nor a Tiny Tapeout chip has a configuration flash

## ddr

| Board | Variants | What it checks | What the check runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sqrl Acorn | every | the DRAM self-test over the whole DRAM: no errors, bandwidth at least the variant's minimum | the Acorn suite ([what an Acorn check tests](acorn.md#acorn)) |
| Digilent Arty A7 | `a7-35` | the LiteX BIOS calibrates the DDR3 and its memory test passes | loads its test design, then runs [`test_ddr.py`](../../designs/ddr-memory/host/test_ddr.py) |
| Kosagi NeTV2 | `a7-35`, `a7-100` | the LiteX BIOS calibrates the DDR3 and its memory test passes | loads its test design, then runs [`test_ddr.py`](../../designs/ddr-memory/host/test_ddr.py) |

Not for:

* Fomu EVT (`evt`): the Fomu EVT has no DRAM
* TT FPGA Demo Board (`tt-fpga`, `tt-asic`, not yet known): the demo board has no DRAM

## wiring

| Board | Variants | What it checks | What the check runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sqrl Acorn | every | its two cables: P1 (jtag), and P2 (p2-uart, p2-serial and p2-gpio) | derived from [`jtag`](#jtag), [`p2-uart`](#p2-uart), [`p2-serial`](#p2-serial), [`p2-gpio`](#p2-gpio) |
| Digilent Arty A7 | `a7-35` | each Pmod HAT wire but the six on the shared JA/JB pins carries the FPGA pin the cabling map puts there | loads its test design, then runs [`identify_pmod_pins.py`](../../designs/pmod-pin-id/host/identify_pmod_pins.py) |
| Fomu EVT | `evt` | it sits on the Pi's header: its reset, CDONE and SPI flash lines (header) and its UART lines (uart) | derived from [`header`](#header), [`uart`](#uart) |
| Kosagi NeTV2 | `a7-35`, `a7-100` | its wires to the Pi are the header's JTAG lines (jtag) and UART lines (uart) | derived from [`jtag`](#jtag), [`uart`](#uart) |
| TT FPGA Demo Board | `tt-fpga` | each Pmod HAT wire carries the FPGA pin the cabling map puts there (the pin-ID scan) | loads its test design, then runs [`identify_pmod_pins.py`](../../designs/pmod-pin-id/host/identify_pmod_pins.py) |
| TT FPGA Demo Board | `tt-asic` | the RP2040 drives each ui_in and uio line and the Pi reads it on its HAT pin, bit by bit | runs [`tt_pmod_wiring.py`](../../designs/_host/tt_pmod_wiring.py); loads nothing |
| TT FPGA Demo Board | not yet known | the three Pmod ribbons to the Pi's HAT, pin by pin (how depends on the board, not yet said) | what the board's variant calls for, once the check knows it |

## power-cycle

| Board | Variants | What it checks | What the check runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sqrl Acorn | every | the FPGA restarted since the last boot's check (scratch holds its reset value or this boot's marker) | the Acorn suite ([what an Acorn check tests](acorn.md#acorn)) when the check is asked for it (`power_cycle_check`) |

## uart

| Board | Variants | What it checks | What the check runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Digilent Arty A7 | `a7-35` | the UART test design's BIOS banner arrives and printable text echoes back | loads its test design, then runs [`test_uart.py`](../../designs/uart/host/test_uart.py) |
| Fomu EVT | `evt` | a design loaded over DFU echoes printable text back over the header's UART | loads its test design, then runs [`test_uart.py`](../../designs/uart/host/test_uart.py) |
| Kosagi NeTV2 | `a7-35`, `a7-100` | printable text sent to the UART test design echoes back over the header's UART | loads its test design, then runs [`test_uart.py`](../../designs/uart/host/test_uart.py) |
| TT FPGA Demo Board | `tt-fpga` | printable text through the RP2350's bridge to the UART test design echoes back | loads its test design, then runs [`test_uart.py`](../../designs/uart/host/test_uart.py) |

Not for:

* Sqrl Acorn: its UART is on the P2 cable: p2-uart tests it
* TT FPGA Demo Board (`tt-asic`): a Tiny Tapeout chip's projects are fixed in silicon: no UART design can be loaded; the wiring test checks its lines to the Pi
* TT FPGA Demo Board (not yet known): only an FPGA board has a UART test, and the board did not say whether it carries an FPGA

## ethernet

| Board | Variants | What it checks | What the check runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Digilent Arty A7 | `a7-35` | the design answers ARP and ping through the Pi's USB Ethernet adapter cabled to its RJ45 | loads its test design, then runs [`test_ethernet.py`](../../designs/ethernet-test/host/test_ethernet.py) |
| Kosagi NeTV2 | `a7-35`, `a7-100` | the design answers ARP and ping through a Pi USB Ethernet adapter cabled to the NeTV2's RJ45 | not run yet: [#341](https://github.com/fpgas-online/fpgas.online-test-designs/issues/341) |

Not for:

* TT FPGA Demo Board (`tt-fpga`, `tt-asic`, not yet known): the demo board has no Ethernet
